title: Bellow on Sweet angel heavens beckon In your bird song. Wings settled, Love Nestled Your call cast upon clouds wrapped in Warmth of Earth's embrace. I
summary: Bellow on Sweet angel heavens beckon In your bird song. Wings settled, Love Nestled Your call cast upon clouds wrapped in Warmth of Earth's embrace. In sounds and calls We kiss a smiling face As fate beckons Daily. Nestled above On branches of love.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Bellow on
Sweet angel
heavens
beckon
In your bird song.
Wings settled,
Love Nestled
Your call cast upon
clouds wrapped in
Warmth of Earth's
embrace.
In sounds and calls
We kiss a smiling face
As fate beckons
Daily. Nestled above
On branches of love.
